about: sedi-1's maxima (test-plan item 13, choice bounds, this.i 7qx6tl5p): a case at each maximum, which is valid, and one just past it, marked beyond_bound, which asks only that it is not valid. Each fixture is a bundle in the form acdc_build reads.

cases.title: Registry at the maximum of 64 events
cases.description: A credential whose registry holds its inception and 63 updates, 64 events, the most sedi-1 allows, each anchored in the issuer's KEL and the head issued. A sedi-1 verifier should find it valid.

cases.title: Registry past the maximum of 64 events
cases.description: As SB-01, but the registry holds 65 events, one past the maximum. A sedi-1 verifier should not find it valid.
cases.triage: Accepting it means a verifier's work on a credential has no bound the profile states, and two verifiers that pick different limits disagree about the same credential.

cases.title: Aggregate at the maximum of 32 blocks
cases.description: An aggregate credential with 32 attribute blocks, the most sedi-1 allows. A sedi-1 verifier should find it valid.

cases.title: Aggregate past the maximum of 32 blocks
cases.description: As SB-03, but with 33 attribute blocks. A sedi-1 verifier should not find it valid.
cases.triage: Accepting it means a verifier's work on a credential has no bound the profile states, and two verifiers that pick different limits disagree about the same credential.

cases.title: Edge groups at the maximum depth of 8
cases.description: N's I2I edge to F sits in edge groups nested 8 deep, counting the edge section, the most sedi-1 allows. A sedi-1 verifier should find it valid.

cases.title: Edge groups past the maximum depth of 8
cases.description: As SB-05, but nested 9 deep. A sedi-1 verifier should not find it valid.
cases.triage: Accepting it means a verifier's work on a credential has no bound the profile states, and two verifiers that pick different limits disagree about the same credential.

cases.title: Operator list at the maximum of 8
cases.description: N's edge to F has an o list of 8 operators, each I2I, the most sedi-1 allows. A sedi-1 verifier should find it valid.

cases.title: Operator list past the maximum of 8
cases.description: As SB-07, but with 9 operators. A sedi-1 verifier should not find it valid.
cases.triage: Accepting it means a verifier's work on a credential has no bound the profile states, and two verifiers that pick different limits disagree about the same credential.

cases.title: Attribute value at the maximum of 4096 bytes
cases.description: A credential whose name attribute is 4096 bytes long, the most sedi-1 allows. A sedi-1 verifier should find it valid.

cases.title: Attribute value past the maximum of 4096 bytes
cases.description: As SB-09, but the value is 4097 bytes. A sedi-1 verifier should not find it valid.
cases.triage: Accepting it means a verifier's work on a credential has no bound the profile states, and two verifiers that pick different limits disagree about the same credential.

cases.title: Registry salt at the maximum of 44 characters
cases.description: A credential whose registry inception carries as its salt a 256-bit blinding factor (code a), 44 characters in qb64, the longest primitive sedi-1 lets a u hold. A sedi-1 verifier should find it valid.

cases.title: Registry salt past the maximum of 44 characters
cases.description: As SB-11, but the registry's salt is a well-formed 48-character primitive. A sedi-1 verifier should not find it valid.
cases.triage: Accepting it means a verifier's work on a credential has no bound the profile states, and two verifiers that pick different limits disagree about the same credential.
